description: This file declares the dm_network_ssid_list_t class, which manages a list of network SSIDs, providing methods for initialization, configuration, database synchronization, and iteration over network SSID entries. It references external files related to network SSID data structures and database handling.

classes.name: dm_network_ssid_list_t
classes.description: A class for managing a list of network SSIDs with capabilities for initialization, configuration, database synchronization, and iteration, inheriting from dm_network_ssid_t and db_easy_mesh_t.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the network SSID list, setting up configurations necessary for network SSID operations.

methods.name: get_dm_orch_type
methods.description: Retrieves the DM orchestration type for a given network SSID.

methods.name: update_list
methods.description: Updates the network SSID list with the specified operation.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Deletes all entries from the network SSID list.

methods.name: analyze_config
methods.description: Analyzes JSON configuration data and populates command structures accordingly.

methods.name: init_columns
methods.description: Sets up columns for the network SSID list.

methods.name: sync_db
methods.description: Synchronizes the in-memory database with the provided database client and context.

methods.name: update_db
methods.description: Updates the database with specific operation type and data.

methods.name: search_db
methods.description: Searches the database for a specific key.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares this object with another db_easy_mesh_t object for equality.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration in the database client from a JSON object.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Configures a specific network SSID in the database client.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration settings from a JSON object.

methods.name: get_first_network_ssid
methods.description: Returns the first network SSID; pure virtual, must be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: get_next_network_ssid
methods.description: Provides the next network SSID in the list; pure virtual.

methods.name: get_network_ssid
methods.description: Finds and returns the network SSID corresponding to a key; pure virtual.

methods.name: remove_network_ssid
methods.description: Removes a network SSID by key; pure virtual.

methods.name: put_network_ssid
methods.description: Stores a network SSID with an associated key; pure virtual.
